defensives.name: Blur
defensives.usage_rule: 25% damage reduction for 10 seconds, so pre-press it for scripted raid damage that lands inside a burst window you do not want to walk out of.

defensives.name: Darkness
defensives.usage_rule: Drop the 8 second avoidance bubble on a known heavy raid-wide hit and coordinate the placement with the healers, since it covers everyone standing in it.
